speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: and The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung): We mould the future of Singapore and aim to bring out the best in every child.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We seek to nurture them into upright, confident, knowledgeable and skilful young adults, equipped with a strong and lifelong curiosity and passion for learning.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Together with parents and our partners in the community, we will build on our efforts to bring out the best in every child, regardless of his or her starting point.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will guide, inspire and support every child to nurture a love for learning and pursue a meaningful and purposeful life through a student-centric, values-driven education.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will provide wider exposure and opportunities for students to discover and build on their interests and talents in a range of areas and develop important life skills from a young age.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: At the same time, we will continue various efforts to reduce excessive focus on academic results, so that learning is more enjoyable, examinations are not overly perceived to be high-stake endeavours and students have more time and space to pursue a broader range of interests, sustain their curiosity, cultivate an innovative spirit and pursue a well-rounded education.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: In the preschool sector, we will continue to develop, refine and share with the wider sector quality kindergarten curriculum and age-appropriate teaching and learning resources.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will strengthen programmes in Primary schools to help students discover their strengths and interests in areas, such as arts, music and sports.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: A stronger emphasis will be placed on outdoor education, to build up ruggedness and resilience in our students.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will create a diverse landscape of Secondary schools with distinctive programmes in various domains and applied learning opportunities, to provide more options for students to develop their interests in their chosen field.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: The delivery of 21st century competencies will be strengthened in the Junior College (JC) curriculum to better prepare JC graduates for further learning and to develop individuals with sound character, resilience and humility to serve and lead the community.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: The use of infocomm technology resources will be deepened to better achieve our desired education outcomes.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Through providing access to quality MOE-developed or curated online resources, students can learn anytime, anywhere, at their own pace and in collaboration with their 	Page: 28 peers.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Our educators are instrumental in educating our next generation.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will enrich pedagogical skills and content mastery of teachers by strengthening teacher training and ongoing professional development, so that they can better impart 21st century competencies and sound values like respect, responsibility, integrity, care, resilience and harmony, which remain core to our desired outcomes of education.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Young people have diverse aspirations and desire to contribute to society, nation, and mankind in a variety of ways.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We have established Education and Career Guidance (ECG) Centres, with a structured ECG curriculum and deployed ECG Counsellors to Secondary schools, JCs, ITEs and Polytechnics.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: They interact with students and help them better understand their strengths and uncover their passions and aspirations for the future.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will support students by developing multiple pathways, spanning diverse fields from science and technology to social services, creative arts and hospitality, at the post-Secondary and tertiary levels to develop their knowledge and skills in their areas of interest.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Whatever the pathway chosen, our students will learn the latest knowledge and skills and build a strong foundation for continual learning throughout their lives.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: This is the best way to prepare them for the future.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: ITE, through its three comprehensive campuses, will continue to develop useful hands-on and industry-relevant skills for our young.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Polytechnics will continue to provide high quality, practice-based education in a dynamic and progressive education environment.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will focus on learning not just in school, but also in the workplace.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Aside from quality offerings in traditional fields, there are many more possibilities in the Universities to cater to individuals of varying strengths and interests.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will continue to ensure strong regulation for the private education space, to ensure that students are protected and both institutions and courses meet or exceed minimum quality standards.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Very importantly, our young must leave the education system with the desire and curiosity to continue to learn and hone their skills throughout their lifetimes.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: The objective is not to chase after more and higher qualifications, but to achieve mastery in everything we do.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: As a society, economy and nation, we need to recognise and celebrate different forms of successes and embrace a culture of lifelong learning.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: To achieve this, enabling a better matching of interest and course of study will be key to achieving higher levels of engagement and a passion to deepen one's learning and skills.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Institutes of higher learning will increasingly expand the use of holistic selection practices to assess students 	Page: 29 based on attributes beyond academic scores.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: This entire effort – to discover passions, provide possibilities for a range of pursuits, nurture curiosity and learn for a lifetime to achieve mastery – is SkillsFuture.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: With a strong foundation of skills, expertise and an ability to learn and relearn, we can innovate and adapt to changes much better, both as individuals and as a social and economic collective.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: Education is a partnership among teachers, lecturers, students, parents, counsellors, schools, institutions, employers and communities.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
text: We will continue to strengthen these partnerships, so that this is a lifelong journey we share to nurture our young and mould the future of Singapore.
